title: SREV-052 DNS filter IP entry ownership contract

network_dns_filter.description: NetworkDnsFilter configuration value containing a pattern and optional semicolon-separated IP list

parse_result.description: _inet_xton return value; 1 means a valid parsed address

contracts: WSA_InitNetDnsFilter owns IP_ENTRY allocation while parsing NetworkDnsFilter configuration
_inet_xton returns 1 only for a valid parsed IPv4 or IPv6 address
A valid IP_ENTRY transfers ownership to the entries list
An invalid IP_ENTRY remains owned by the parser and must be freed
An IPv4-mapped IPv6 synthetic entry transfers ownership only after successful allocation
